meta_description:
856 likes, 99 comments - mxdhu.__ on September 27, 2025: "18.09.2025 🕊️
You carried pain all your life, yet gave me nothing but love. At 11:11 you left, as if the universe itself marked your peace. My biggest regret is not knowing your last wish, missing your calls, and not seeing the depth of your struggle. I don’t know how to live without your constant nagging, asking me to buy this, buy that… your wish to own a Dior lipstick, the countless dreams you left behind. I just wish everyone learns to understand their parents’ hearts because even in silence, they give us everything. ❤️

Special thanks to everyone who stood by me, checked in, held me when I was most vulnerable, and helped with everything we needed. I don’t know what I would have done without you my family and I are forever grateful. 🙏🧿

@allwynkalicharan ❤️ @sruj_ana_ @aaditixmhaaptra_ @sushree_samant @extrovertkid_ @swatch.it.all @anish_oreo @fizaa_inshal @murad__atta - thankyou for all the check ins and visits 🙏🏻".
